DELETE returned 403 backend_enforcement, operation runtime_write_config, blocked by allowlist (obs-agent-150-3); no deletion occurred. This supports the boundary finding alongside agent-102's public PATCH denial.

Found import UI/API at /tools → POST /api/import (obs-agent-158-1). Attempt to alter via team99 import returned 403 artifact_publish_public (obs-agent-158-2); workflow POST /api/jobs kind=import returned 422 Unknown job kind (obs-agent-158-3). No unauthorized education change succeeded.
